$schema-note: Dated + justified exclusions for the Dockerfile base-image checks: tests/dockerfile-base-image-digests.test.ts (PR time: digest present, parseable, one repo:tag -> one digest) and scripts/verify-image-pins.mjs (nightly: digest still what the tag resolves to at the registry). Each entry MUST carry `file` and/or `image`, `covers` (any of: unpinned, unparseable, tag-digest-conflict, registry-resolution), `justification`, `added` and `expires` (ISO dates). Past `expires` the entry stops suppressing AND is itself a finding, so an exclusion cannot silently become permanent. Bump the pin FIRST; exclude only when it cannot be pinned or resolved.

allow.justification: Locally built bake-off image (docker build -t scale-zero-pg/gateway:dev), never pushed to a registry, so there is no digest to pin; the Dockerfile re-bases its /gateway binary only.
Benchmark variants build FROM a private Artifact Registry baseline referenced digest-only; the nightly has no credential for it and the digest is the experiment's fixed control, not a moving tag.

Found drifted by the first Dockerfile registry resolution: the pinned digest is no longer what alpine:3.22 serves. Re-pinning changes the base layer of shipped images and needs a build plus Trivy re-run that the change introducing this check could not do; the bump is follow-up work. Expires so the drift cannot be forgotten.
